mapper.select: select (select count(*) from his_registration where reg_date = curdate()) todayReg, (select ifnull(sum(amount),0) from his_charge where charge_status = '1' and date(settle_time) = curdate()) todayRevenue, (select count(*) from his_admission where adm_status = '0') inHospital, (select count(*) from his_bed where status = '0') freeBeds, (select count(*) from his_patient) totalPatients, (select count(*) from his_drug where stock <= stock_warn) warnDrugs, (select count(*) from his_surgery where status = '0') pendingSurgery, (select count(*) from his_lab_test where status in ('0','1','2')) pendingLab
select date_format(reg_date,'%m-%d') day, count(*) cnt from his_registration where reg_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 13 day) group by reg_date order by reg_date

select date_format(t.d,'%m-%d') day, t.amount from ( select date(settle_time) d, ifnull(sum(amount),0) amount from his_charge where charge_status = '1' and settle_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 29 day) group by date(settle_time) ) t order by t.d
select d.dept_name name, count(*) value from his_registration r join his_department d on d.dept_id = r.dept_id group by r.dept_id order by value desc

select i.drug_name name, sum(i.quantity) value from his_prescription_item i join his_prescription rx on rx.rx_id = i.rx_id where rx.status in ('1','2') group by i.drug_id, i.drug_name order by value desc limit 10
select w.ward_name name, count(*) total, sum(case when b.status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) used from his_bed b join his_ward w on w.ward_id = b.ward_id group by b.ward_id order by b.ward_id

select case source_type when '0' then '挂号费' when '1' then '处方费' when '2' then '检验费' when '3' then '检查费' when '4' then '住院费' when '5' then '手术费' else '其他' end name, ifnull(sum(amount),0) value from his_charge where charge_status = '1' group by source_type

select d.doctor_name name, count(*) value, ifnull(sum(v.status = '2'),0) finished from his_visit v join his_doctor d on d.doctor_id = v.doctor_id where v.visit_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 29 day) group by v.doctor_id, d.doctor_name order by value desc limit 10
select case r.time_slot when '0' then '上午' when '1' then '下午' when '2' then '晚间' else '其他' end name, count(*) value from his_registration r group by r.time_slot

select ifnull(d.dept_name,'其他') name, ifnull(sum(c.amount),0) value from his_charge c left join his_registration r on c.source_type = '0' and c.source_id = r.reg_id left join his_prescription p on c.source_type = '1' and c.source_id = p.rx_id left join his_admission a on c.source_type = '4' and c.source_id = a.adm_id left join his_surgery s on c.source_type = '5' and c.source_id = s.surgery_id left join his_department d on d.dept_id = coalesce(r.dept_id, (select v.dept_id from his_visit v where v.visit_id = p.visit_id), a.dept_id, s.dept_id) where c.charge_status = '1' group by ifnull(d.dept_name,'其他') order by value desc

select (select count(*) from his_registration where date_format(reg_date,'%Y-%m') = date_format(curdate(),'%Y-%m')) monthReg, (select ifnull(sum(amount),0) from his_charge where charge_status = '1' and date_format(settle_time,'%Y-%m') = date_format(curdate(),'%Y-%m')) monthRevenue, (select count(*) from his_admission where date_format(in_date,'%Y-%m') = date_format(curdate(),'%Y-%m')) monthAdmit, (select count(*) from his_admission where date_format(out_date,'%Y-%m') = date_format(curdate(),'%Y-%m')) monthDischarge, (select count(*) from his_surgery where status = '2' and date_format(update_time,'%Y-%m') = date_format(curdate(),'%Y-%m')) monthSurgery, (select count(*) from his_prescription where date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m') = date_format(curdate(),'%Y-%m')) monthRx
